# Error codes

A failure the engine can name carries an `FLX-nnnn` code. The thousands digit says which part of the engine raised it. `fluxsim explain FLX-nnnn` prints the same text offline, and `fluxsim explain --list` lists every code.

## 1000: canonicalisation

| Code | What it means |
|---|---|
| [FLX-1001](./FLX-1001.md) | float value in a document being canonicalised |
| [FLX-1002](./FLX-1002.md) | digest comparison across two domains |
| [FLX-1003](./FLX-1003.md) | integer outside the JSON safe-integer domain |
| [FLX-1004](./FLX-1004.md) | mapping key cannot be coerced to a string |
| [FLX-1005](./FLX-1005.md) | value class has no canonical JSON form |
| [FLX-1006](./FLX-1006.md) | non-finite Decimal in a document being canonicalised |
| [FLX-1007](./FLX-1007.md) | two mapping keys collide after canonicalisation |

|---|---|
| [FLX-2101](./FLX-2101.md) | the bundle's inputDigest has moved since the plan was recorded |

| [FLX-2103](./FLX-2103.md) | trace op outside the flux-trace/1 vocabulary |
| [FLX-2104](./FLX-2104.md) | trace op field set does not match flux-trace/1 |

| [FLX-2107](./FLX-2107.md) | no recorded plan at this run id |

| [FLX-2109](./FLX-2109.md) | no applied run at this run id |
| [FLX-2110](./FLX-2110.md) | run artifacts do not reproduce the recorded run digest |
| [FLX-2111](./FLX-2111.md) | a --committed-slice names an expose this run does not emit |
| [FLX-2112](./FLX-2112.md) | the run id is not a safe identifier |
| [FLX-2113](./FLX-2113.md) | the run directory does not belong to the plan it holds |
| [FLX-2114](./FLX-2114.md) | the run digest moved from the recorded golden baseline |
| [FLX-2201](./FLX-2201.md) | run touched a seed-tree path the plan did not anticipate |
| [FLX-2202](./FLX-2202.md) | seed-tree input outside its declared domain |
| [FLX-2301](./FLX-2301.md) | the run's cast does not resolve |
| [FLX-2302](./FLX-2302.md) | journey transition is not in the taxonomy |
| [FLX-2303](./FLX-2303.md) | journey step budget exhausted |
